known_risk_areas.area: Generated package packets can drift from the membership ledger
known_risk_areas.mitigation: L12 packet membership currency check; L21 WP-I10-003 structural check; rebuild from authoritative work-packages.json
known_risk_areas.history: WP-I10-003 previously described two requirements while owning three; corrected and regression-tested

known_risk_areas.area: Validators could pass on keyword presence instead of structure
known_risk_areas.mitigation: L21 validates structured amendment fields; validator-audit stage 9 of the pre-GPT audit
known_risk_areas.history: L21 was substring-based; rewritten to structured validation

known_risk_areas.area: Adversarial fixtures could share one mutation across many purposes
known_risk_areas.mitigation: Every fixture copies a valid baseline, applies one mutation, and asserts one intended error
known_risk_areas.history: Amendment fixtures previously reused one empty artifact; replaced with independent fixtures

known_risk_areas.area: Component decision ownership can contradict the technical DAG
known_risk_areas.mitigation: L5 required technical edges; L19 consumer dependency and self-consumer checks
known_risk_areas.history: Installer/signing tools ownership moved from WP-I15-005 to WP-I15-001 to match the reviewed order

known_risk_areas.area: New memberships or dependencies can lack Pass B review rows
known_risk_areas.mitigation: L17 requires REVIEWED_CONFIRMED rows for every membership and dependency
known_risk_areas.history: CAN-LAM-AI-090 and 20 component-decision edges lacked review rows; added

known_risk_areas.area: Independent verification rows can lack item-specific rationale
known_risk_areas.mitigation: L18 requires >=40 character item-specific rationale per row
known_risk_areas.history: 465 contract/test/exit-gate rows lacked the rationale column; enriched

known_risk_areas.area: Certification pipelines can persist the superseded declaration or stale counts
known_risk_areas.mitigation: L15 and L20 enforce the exact new declaration; pass3_persist_certification.py computes counts from authoritative data
known_risk_areas.history: Pass 3 pipeline wrote the old declaration and hardcoded pre-amendment counts; corrected

known_risk_areas.area: The stronger-model override amendment must propagate everywhere
known_risk_areas.mitigation: L21 checks the amendment object, component rules, packet sections, and membership
known_risk_areas.history: Amendment propagated into WP-I10-003 objective, contracts, schemas, tests, exit gate

known_risk_areas.area: Final certification could declare PASS from saved text without proving prerequisites
known_risk_areas.mitigation: Gated certification writes PASS only after every gate passes; every required file is hashed; Layer 3 membership is verified file-by-file; the full Graphify SHA manifest is recomputed and compared; L20 independently re-verifies all evidence from raw files
known_risk_areas.history: Previous final_certification.py wrote PASS unconditionally, skipped missing Layer 3 files, hardcoded empty evidence arrays, did not bind authoritative sources, and L20 trusted saved PASS text; corrected and regression-tested with 20 new fixtures (F116-F135)

known_risk_areas.area: A provisional certification could survive a process interruption with final PASS semantics
known_risk_areas.mitigation: Every persisted state before the final atomic publication is status PROVISIONAL with the NOT CERTIFIED declaration, implementation_planning_100_percent_complete false, first_allowed_package null, the final-validation blocker, and the determinism and final-validation gates PENDING; stale PASS is invalidated at run start; final records are built in memory, validated, written to temp files, fsynced, atomically replaced, and the PASS certification is published last
known_risk_areas.history: Provisional certification previously used status PASS with all gates PASS before Stage 2 completed; defect PROVISIONAL_PASS_CAN_SURVIVE_PROCESS_INTERRUPTION closed with fixtures F136-F139

known_risk_areas.area: Layer 3 envelope membership could be made self-consistent while omitting canonical files
known_risk_areas.mitigation: Layer 3 verification requires set(envelope.files) == set(LAYER3_FILES), canonical deterministic sorted ordering, set(envelope.fileHashes.keys()) == set(LAYER3_FILES), and envelope.fileCount == len(LAYER3_FILES); every canonical file must exist, be readable, be hashed, match its recorded hash, and contribute to the digest
known_risk_areas.history: verify_layer3_envelope() verified only envelope-listed files; defect LAYER3_CAN_OMIT_CANONICAL_MEMBER closed with fixtures F140-F145

known_risk_areas.area: Missing or malformed exclusion sets could pass certification without exact canonical membership or rationales
known_risk_areas.mitigation: Exact canonical exclusion sets are required for Layer 1, Layer 3, and the full Graphify SHA manifest; every exclusion must have a non-empty specific rationale; missing fields, missing/unexpected members, and missing/empty/generic rationales fail
known_risk_areas.history: Exclusion validation tolerated missing/malformed excluded fields; defect CERTIFICATION_EXCLUSION_SET_NOT_STRICT closed with fixtures F146-F153

deferred_claims: Exact AI checkpoint selection is deferred to model-registry work packages.
